title: Model ≠ Part
summary: Models are CONTAINERS — no Position, no Size, no Color, no physics. Only BaseParts (Part, MeshPart…) have those. 'attempt to index nil with Position' on a model is this gotcha.

explanation.whatItIs: The category confusion: models GROUP parts; parts ARE physical. The properties live on the physical things.
explanation.whyItExists: Separation of container vs content lets you organize many parts without pretending the group is an object.
symptoms: Trying to tween/resize a Model directly
CanCollide/Transparency on a model silently doing nothing
explanation.fix: For location: model:GetPivot().Position; to move: PivotTo. For physical properties: iterate the parts (GetDescendants, IsA("BasePart")).
tips: PrimaryPart gives a designated 'main' part for legacy workflows
Bulk styling: for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then …
commonMistakes: Treating the model like a big part
Setting physics properties expecting them to cascade — they don't

examples.title: Model-aware code
examples.code:
local car = workspace.Car   -- a Model

-- ❌ car.Position / car.Transparency

-- ✅ Where is it?
print(car:GetPivot().Position)

-- ✅ Move the whole thing:
car:PivotTo(car:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 0, -10))

-- ✅ Style every part inside:
for _, obj in car:GetDescendants() do
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        obj.Transparency = 0.5
    end
end
